title: Tracial projection methods and uniform property Gamma
summary: For a simple, separable, unital, infinite-dimensional, nuclear, stably finite C ∗ -algebra with traces, real rank zero of the uniform tracial ultrapower of its uniform tracial completion implies uniform property Γ. This answers Problem XXI of Schafhauser, Tikuisis and White affirmatively. Independently, strict comparison implies Jiang–Su absorption for simple, separable, unital, infinite-dimensional nuclear algebras, resolving the unital Toms–Winter conjecture.
